_readme: Copy this file to config/models.json and edit it. No code changes are needed to add a model.
A model id is <prefix>/<model>. Resolution: an exact entry in 'models' wins; otherwise a 'providers'
entry matching the prefix supplies everything but the model name; otherwise the built-in presets
Fields: adapter ('openai' for any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint, or 'ollama'),
endpoint (full URL), model (models only), apiKeyEnv (env var holding the key, or null for none),
supportsTemperatureZero (true, false, or null = unknown until a --runs 3 check). false makes the
runner refuse to score without --i-cannot-control-temperature, and omits temperature from requests.
Optional: headers (extra HTTP headers), maxRetries (transport retries, default 2).
